title: Facet vocabulary (v1)
description: Shape of config/harvest/facets/<axis>.v1.json. One file per axis; the file is the SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for its axis, and schemas/harvest/facets.generated.v1.json is derived from it. This schema checks shape only — membership counts, tier splits, axis disjointness and the record_only rules are semantic and live in scripts/harvest/check_facets.py, because a schema cannot express them.

axis.description: Singular, and identical to the axis names used in case_facets.unresolved[].axis.

vocabulary_version.description: Recorded on every classified record as case_facets.vocabulary_versions.<plural axis>. Bumping it is how a vocabulary change becomes auditable.

facet_slug.description: Identical pattern to record.v1.json#/$defs/facet_slug. Must already be a slug: slugify(slug) == slug.

entry.description: Every field is required on every entry. An omitted 'exclusions' would be an unstated assumption about where the value stops, which is exactly the ambiguity this vocabulary exists to remove — so an entry with nothing to exclude says so with an empty array.

display_name.description: For UI only. It is NOT required to slugify to the slug: 'Financial Services & Insurance' slugifies to 'financial-services-and-insurance', while the approved slug is 'financial-services-insurance'. The slug is authoritative.

positive_terms.description: Terms that, when found IN THE DOCUMENT, may support this value. They are candidate evidence, never a rule: a match is necessary, not sufficient.

exclusions.description: Readings this value must NOT absorb. Empty array = nothing to exclude, stated deliberately.

disambiguation.description: Prose boundary against the nearest competing value, on this axis or another. Empty string when no near miss exists.

parent_group.description: UI navigation grouping ONLY. Never semantic, never used by the classifier, never part of coverage.

coverage_policy.description: The scheduler tier. record_only means: recorded faithfully when evidenced, never actively sought, target_min 0.

replaced_by.description: Set only when status is 'deprecated'. A deprecated value still validates on historical records; it may not be newly assigned.
